(a) & (b)
```{r}
model_quad <- lm(price ~ I(sqft^2), data = collegetown)
summary(model_quad)
```
```{r}
test_marginal_effect <- function(sqft_val, target = 13) {
  alpha2_hat <- coef(model_quad)["I(sqft^2)"]
  se_alpha2 <- summary(model_quad)$coefficients["I(sqft^2)", "Std. Error"]
  marginal_est <- 2 * alpha2_hat * sqft_val
  se_marginal <- 2 * sqft_val * se_alpha2
  t_stat <- (marginal_est - target) / se_marginal
  df_residual <- df.residual(model_quad)
  p_val <- pt(t_stat, df_residual, lower.tail = FALSE)
  critical_t <- qt(0.95, df_residual)
  
  cat("\n--- SQFT =", sqft_val, "下的檢定結果 ---")
  cat("\n邊際效應估計值:", marginal_est)
  cat("\nt 統計量:", t_stat)
  cat("\n臨界值 (t_c):", critical_t)
  cat("\np-value:", p_val)
  return(list(t = t_stat, p = p_val))
}

# (a) 
test_marginal_effect(20)

# (b)
test_marginal_effect(40)
```

(c)
```{r}
new_data <- data.frame(sqft = 20)
conf_interval <- predict(model_quad, newdata = new_data, interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)

cat("\nSQFT=20 的期望價格預測與 95% 信賴區間：\n")
print(conf_interval)
```

(c)
```{r}
tuna$price1 <- 100 * tuna$apr1

confint(model_tuna, "price1", level = 0.95)
```

(d)
```{r}
new_price <- data.frame(price1 = 70)
predict(model_tuna, new_price, interval = "confidence", level = 0.90)
```
(e)
```{r}
beta2_hat <- coef(model_tuna)["price1"]
mean_price <- mean(tuna$price1)
mean_sales <- mean(tuna$sal1)

elasticity_mean <- beta2_hat * (mean_price / mean_sales)

ci_beta2 <- confint(model_tuna, "price1", level = 0.95)
ci_elasticity <- ci_beta2 * (mean_price / mean_sales)

cat("平均值處的彈性:", elasticity_mean, "\n")
cat("彈性的 95% 信賴區間:", ci_elasticity)
```
(f)
```{r}
target_beta2 <- -3 * (mean_sales / mean_price)
se_beta2 <- summary(model_tuna)$coefficients["price1", "Std. Error"]

t_stat_f <- (beta2_hat - target_beta2) / se_beta2
p_val_f <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_stat_f), df = df.residual(model_tuna))

cat("檢定 H0: epsilon = -3 的 t 統計量:", t_stat_f, "p 值:", p_val_f)
```
